items.title_cn: 计划性双通道技术在超声内镜引导下治疗慢性胰腺炎合并胰管完全断裂的大型症状性胰腺假性囊肿中的应用
items.title_en: Use of a planned dual-gateway technique for endoscopic ultrasound-guided management of a large symptomatic pancreatic pseudocyst associated with complete pancreatic duct disruption in chronic pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 超声内镜（EUS）引导下引流是症状性胰腺假性囊肿的首选治疗方法。对于存在完全性胰管断裂的患者，在移除管腔对置金属支架（LAMS）后，可能需要延长透壁引流时间以防止复发。然而，LAMS移除后假性囊肿腔的塌陷可能妨碍后续长期透壁塑料支架的置入。我们描述了一种计划性双通道技术，用于治疗一例合并完全性胰管断裂的慢性胰腺炎患者中的大型症状性胰腺假性囊肿。一名49岁男性患者在经内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）中经乳头桥接失败后，接受了EUS引导下囊肿胃吻合术。该操作经过审慎规划，包括同时置入一根平行的透壁双猪尾塑料支架和一根内含同轴塑料支架的LAMS。20天后复查EUS证实囊腔完全消退，遂移除LAMS及同轴塑料支架。正如预期，LAMS移除后囊腔立即塌陷，无法再置入额外的透壁塑料支架；然而，先前置入的平行塑料支架仍原位保留，以提供长期引流。术后3个月复查计算机断层扫描（CT）显示假性囊肿完全消退且无复发，患者在6个月随访期间未出现假性囊肿相关症状。这种计划性双通道技术可考虑由经验丰富的介入内镜医师在经严格筛选的、需要在EUS引导下假性囊肿引流术后接受延长透壁引流的患者中应用。
items.abstract_en: Endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)-guided drainage is the preferred treatment for symptomatic pancreatic pseudocysts.In patients with complete pancreatic duct disruption, prolonged transmural drainage may be needed to prevent recurrence after removal of lumen-apposing metal stents (LAMS).However, collapse of the pseudocyst cavity after LAMS removal may can prevent subsequent placement of long-term transmural plastic stents.We describe a planned dual-gateway technique for managing a large symptomatic pancreatic pseudocyst associated with complete pancreatic duct disruption in a patient with chronic pancreatitis.A 49-year-old man underwent EUS-guided cystogastrostomy after transpapillary bridging during endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography was unsuccessful.The procedure was deliberately planned to include simultaneous placement of a parallel transmural double-pigtail plastic stent and a LAMS containing a coaxial plastic stent.EUS performed 20 days later confirmed complete resolution of the collection, allowing removal of the LAMS and coaxial plastic stent.As anticipated, the cavity collapsed immediately after LAMS removal, preventing placement of an additional transmural plastic stent; however, the previously placed parallel plastic stent remained in situ to provide long-term drainage.Follow-up computed tomography at 3 months demonstrated complete pseudocyst resolution without recurrence, and the patient remained free of pseudocyst-related symptoms during 6 months of follow-up.This planned dual-gateway technique may be considered by experienced interventional endoscopists in carefully selected patients who require prolonged transmural drainage after EUS-guided pseudocyst drainage.
items.summary_cn: 该研究提出一种计划性双通道技术，在EUS引导下引流合并完全性胰管断裂的胰腺假性囊肿时，同时放置平行双猪尾塑料支架和同轴塑料支架的LAMS，以在LAMS移除后维持长期引流，避免复发。随访3个月CT显示囊肿完全消退，6个月内无复发。

items.title_cn: 红细胞分布宽度与白蛋白比值联合SOFA评分与急性胰腺炎患者28天全因死亡率的相关性：基于MIMIC-IV数据库的回顾性研究
items.title_en: Correlation of red cell distribution width-to-albumin ratio combined with SOFA score with 28-day all-cause mortality in patients with acute pancreatitis: A retrospective study based on the MIMIC-IV database
items.abstract_cn: 目的：本研究旨在评估红细胞分布宽度与白蛋白比值（RAR）联合序贯器官衰竭评估（SOFA）评分对急性胰腺炎（AP）患者28天全因死亡率的预测价值。方法：本研究回顾性分析了来自MIMIC-IV（v3.1）数据库的702例AP患者的临床数据。采用单变量和多变量Cox回归分析评估RAR改良SOFA评分与28天全因死亡率之间的关系。此外，通过约登指数确定最佳截断值，并利用受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线和Kaplan-Meier（K-M）生存分析评估联合指标的预测性能。最后，通过亚组分析检验研究结果在不同人群中的稳健性。结果：本研究共纳入702例入住重症监护病房（ICU）的AP患者，并对其28天全因死亡率进行了分析。单变量和多变量Cox回归分析均表明，RAR改良SOFA评分是ICU中AP患者28天全因死亡率的独立危险因素。ROC曲线分析显示，RAR改良SOFA评分相较于其他评分系统（包括单独的RAR和SOFA）具有更优的预测能力。此外，K-M生存曲线分析显示，高值组（RAR改良SOFA评分≥12.69）的死亡率显著高于低值组（RAR改良SOFA评分<12.69）。结论：RAR改良SOFA评分显著提高了对AP患者28天全因死亡率的预测准确性。
items.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: The objective of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of the red cell distribution width-to-albumin ratio (RAR) in conjunction with the Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score for predicting 28-day all-cause mortality in patients with acute pancreatitis (AP). METHODS: In this study, we conducted a retrospective analysis of clinical data from 702 patients with AP sourced from the MIMIC-IV (v3.1) database. We evaluated the relationship between the RAR-modified SOFA score and 28-day all-cause mortality using both univariate and multivariate Cox regression analyses. Furthermore, the optimal cutoff value was determined using the Youden index, and the predictive performance of the combined indicator was evaluated through Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curves and Kaplan-Meier (K-M) survival analysis. Finally, we examined the robustness of our findings across different populations through subgroup analyses. RESULTS: A total of 702 patients with AP admitted to the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) were included in this study, and their 28-day all-cause mortality was analyzed. Both univariate and multivariate Cox regression analyses indicated that the RAR-modified SOFA score served as an independent risk factor for 28-day all-cause mortality in ICU patients with AP. ROC curve analysis demonstrated that the RAR-modified SOFA score exhibited superior predictive ability compared to other scoring systems, including RAR and SOFA alone. Additionally, K-M survival curve analysis revealed that the mortality rate was significantly higher in the high-value group (RAR-modified SOFA score ≥ 12.69) compared to the low-value group (RAR-modified SOFA score < 12.69). CONCLUSIONS: The RAR-modified SOFA score significantly enhances the predictive accuracy for 28-day all-cause mortality in patients with AP.
items.summary_cn: RAR改良SOFA评分是ICU急性胰腺炎患者28天全因死亡率的独立危险因素，且其预测能力优于单独的RAR或SOFA评分；高值组（评分≥12.69）死亡率显著高于低值组。

items.title_cn: 重症坏死性胰腺炎内镜下坏死组织清除术中胃十二指肠动脉假性动脉瘤 catastrophic 破裂：一种罕见的致命并发症
items.title_en: Catastrophic Gastroduodenal Artery Pseudoaneurysm Rupture During Endoscopic Necrosectomy in Severe Necrotizing Pancreatitis: A Rare Life-Threatening Complication
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 假性动脉瘤形成是坏死性胰腺炎罕见但可能致命的并发症，因其存在破裂风险。我们报告一例28岁男性患者，患有包裹性胰腺坏死，在内镜超声引导下坏死组织清除术中出现假性动脉瘤破裂导致的大出血，术中发生心脏骤停。患者需立即行心肺复苏及急诊血管造影，造影明确了出血来源，并通过弹簧圈栓塞实现止血。经及时的多学科干预，患者存活。本病例强调了坏死性胰腺炎中血管并发症的不可预测性，以及快速多学科反应在处理危及生命的大出血中的关键作用。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Pseudoaneurysm formation is a rare but potentially fatal complication of necrotizing pancreatitis due to the risk of rupture. We report a 28-year-old man with walled-off pancreatic necrosis who developed catastrophic hemorrhage from a ruptured pseudoaneurysm during endoscopic ultrasound-guided necrosectomy, resulting in intraprocedural cardiac arrest. The patient required immediate cardiopulmonary resuscitation and emergent angiography, which identified the bleeding source and achieved hemostasis via coil embolization. He survived following prompt multidisciplinary intervention. This case highlights the unpredictable nature of vascular complications in necrotizing pancreatitis and the critical role of rapid multidisciplinary response in managing life-threatening hemorrhage.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了重症坏死性胰腺炎患者在内镜超声引导下坏死清除术中发生胃十二指肠动脉假性动脉瘤破裂导致灾难性出血和术中心脏骤停，通过紧急血管造影和弹簧圈栓塞成功止血并存活，强调了血管并发症的不可预测性及快速多学科反应在管理致命性出血中的关键作用。

items.title_cn: 靶向p38α通过抑制mtDNA/cGAS-STING信号通路促进Parkin介导的线粒体自噬以减轻重症急性胰腺炎
items.title_en: Targeting p38α promotes Parkin-mediated mitophagy to attenuate severe acute pancreatitis via suppressing the mtDNA/cGAS-STING signaling pathway
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）是一种危及生命的急性炎症性疾病，以全身性炎症和高死亡率为特征，目前临床实践中仍严重缺乏针对性的靶向治疗策略。线粒体功能障碍和线粒体自噬受损已被证实是SAP的关键病理驱动因素；然而，调控线粒体质量控制的精确分子靶点仍不明确。在本研究中，我们鉴定出p38α（MAPK14）是SAP进展过程中线粒体自噬的核心调控因子。结合生物信息学筛选与实验性SAP模型，我们证实胰腺腺泡细胞中p38α异常过度激活。机制上，活化的p38α磷酸化E3泛素连接酶Parkin的S131位点。这种位点特异性磷酸化触发“泛素化开关”，选择性加速Parkin的K48连接多聚泛素化依赖性降解，同时损害其K63连接的自身泛素化及功能活性。因此，Parkin依赖性线粒体自噬的阻断导致受损线粒体积累和线粒体DNA（mtDNA）大量泄漏至细胞质中，进而激活cGAS-STING信号级联反应，加剧无菌性炎症风暴。药理学抑制p38α或基因过表达磷酸化缺陷型Parkin突变体（S131A）可有效恢复线粒体自噬通量，消除细胞质mtDNA积累，并抑制cGAS-STING介导的促炎细胞因子释放，从而显著减轻SAP的病理损伤。本研究阐明了p38α/Parkin/mtDNA/cGAS-STING信号轴在SAP发病机制中的新作用，并强调靶向p38α介导的Parkin S131磷酸化开关是临床干预SAP的一种有前景的治疗策略。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) is a life-threatening acute inflammatory disorder characterized by systemic inflammation and high mortality, for which specific targeted therapeutic strategies are still severely lacking in clinical practice. Mitochondrial dysfunction and impaired mitophagy have been validated as critical pathological drivers of SAP; nevertheless, the precise molecular targets governing the dysregulation of mitochondrial quality control remain poorly defined. Herein, we identify p38α (MAPK14) as a central regulator of mitophagy during SAP progression. Combining bioinformatic screening with an experimental SAP model, we demonstrate aberrantly hyperactivated p38α in pancreatic acinar cells. Mechanistically, activated p38α phosphorylates the S131 site of the E3 ubiquitin ligase Parkin. This site-specific phosphorylation triggers a “ubiquitination switch”, which selectively accelerates K48-linked polyubiquitination-dependent degradation of Parkin while impairing its K63-linked autoubiquitination and functional activity. Consequently, blockade of Parkin-dependent mitophagy results in accumulation of damaged mitochondria and massive leakage of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) into the cytoplasm, which further activates the cGAS-STING signaling cascade and exacerbates the sterile inflammatory storm. Pharmacological inhibition of p38α or genetic overexpression of the phosphorylation-deficient Parkin mutant (S131A) effectively restores mitophagic flux, eliminates cytoplasmic mtDNA accumulation, and suppresses cGAS-STING-mediated pro-inflammatory cytokine release, thereby markedly alleviating pathological injury in SAP. Our study illuminates a novel role of the p38α/Parkin/mtDNA/cGAS-STING signaling axis in the pathogenesis of SAP, and highlights targeting the p38α-mediated Parkin S131 phosphorylation switch as a promising therapeutic strategy for clinical intervention against SAP.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现p38α通过磷酸化Parkin的S131位点，触发其泛素化降解，抑制线粒体自噬，导致mtDNA泄漏并激活cGAS-STING信号通路，加剧重症急性胰腺炎；抑制p38α或表达S131A突变体可恢复线粒体自噬并减轻胰腺损伤。

items.title_cn: 热休克蛋白-70家族基因活性变化与早期急性胰腺炎严重程度相关
items.title_en: Changes in Activity of Heat Shock Protein-70 Family Genes is Associated With Early Acute Pancreatitis Severity
items.abstract_cn: 目的：急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种疼痛且可能危及生命的疾病，迄今尚无有效治疗方法。基因组评估有望成为预测AP严重程度的潜在方法。我们假设热休克蛋白70（HSP70）家族基因中的单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）及其表达变化可能在AP严重程度的早期预测中发挥作用。方法：共研究了44例AP患者和47例年龄、性别匹配的健康对照者。分别使用白细胞提取的总RNA和基因组DNA进行HSPA1A和HSPA1L基因表达分析及启动子区域（HSPA1A：rs1008438和HSPA1L：rs2227956）基因分型分析。结果：AP患者与对照组之间的基因型差异无统计学意义，但AP患者中HSPA1A表达降低2倍。与对照组相比，轻度和轻度/中度AP组中表达下降更为明显（分别为P=0.024和P=0.008）。在整个队列中，AG携带者的HSPA1L表达高于AA携带者（P=0.014），且在AP患者中差异显著（P=0.001）。此外，重度AG病例中HSPA1L表达最高，且与AA基因型携带者相比差异显著（P=0.005）。结论：我们认为HSP70家族基因的表达可能是预测AP疾病严重程度的有价值的标志物。
items.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a painful and potentially life-threatening disorder, with no effective therapy available to date. Genome assessment shows promise as a potential method for predicting AP severity. We hypothesized that single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and expression changes in Heat Shock Protein 70 (HSP70) family genes may play a role in early prediction of AP severity. METHODS: A total of 44 AP patients and 47 age- and sex-matched healthy controls were studied. Leukocyte-extracted total RNA and genomic DNA were used for HSPA1A and HSPA1L gene expression and genotyping in promoter regions (HSPA1A: rs1008438 and HSPA1L: rs2227956) analyses, respectively. RESULTS: No statistically significant differences were found between the genotypes of AP patients and controls, however, HSPA1A expression was 2-fold lower in AP. Decrease in expression was more evident in mild and mild/moderate AP groups vs. controls (P=0.024 and P=0.008, respectively). HSPA1L expression in AG vs. AA carriers was higher in entire cohort (P=0.014) and markedly differed between AP patients (P=0.001). Also, HSPA1L expression was the highest in severe AG cases and significantly differed from AA genotype carriers (P=0.005). CONCLUSIONS: We suggest that HSP70 family genes expression may be a valuable marker for predicting disease severity in AP.
items.summary_cn: HSP70家族基因（HSPA1A和HSPA1L）的表达变化与急性胰腺炎严重程度相关，其中HSPA1A在轻症患者中表达降低，HSPA1L在重症AG基因型携带者中表达最高，提示其表达水平可能作为预测AP严重程度的早期标志物。

items.title_cn: 中重度急性胰腺炎并发高位胃肠损伤的影响因素及预测模型研究
items.title_en: Unraveling the influencing factors and predictive model for high - level gastrointestinal injury complicating moderate - severe acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 目的 探讨中重症急性胰腺炎（MSAP）并发高等级急性胃肠损伤（AGI≥3级）的影响因素，并建立及评价该并发症的预测模型。方法 回顾性分析2022年7月1日至2025年7月1日期间温州医科大学附属东阳人民医院收治的228例MSAP患者。其中，85例并发高等级AGI的患者为观察组，143例未并发高等级AGI的患者为对照组。采用基于LASSO回归的三阶段变量筛选策略确定核心预测因子，随后运用二元logistic回归构建预测模型，并通过bootstrap方法进行内部验证。结果 高脂血症是MSAP最常见的病因。多因素分析显示，高脂血症病因、血浆D-二聚体水平及住院时间为高等级AGI的独立危险因素，而确诊年龄、血清钾（K⁺）及血清钙（Ca²⁺）为保护因素。最终模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.877，经bootstrap验证后升至0.888。模型的灵敏度为80.3%，特异度为81.5%。结论 高脂血症病因、血浆D-二聚体及住院时间为MSAP并发高等级AGI的独立危险因素，而K⁺、Ca²⁺及确诊年龄为MSAP并发高等级AGI的保护因素。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Objective To investigate the influencing factors for Moderately Severe Acute Pancreatitis (MSAP) complicated with high-grade Acute Gastrointestinal Injury (AGI ≥ grade 3), and to establish and evaluate a predictive model for this condition. Methods A retrospective analysis was conducted on 228 patients with MSAP admitted to Dongyang People’s Hospital, Wenzhou Medical University, China. between July1, 2022 and July 1,2025. Among them, 85 patients with high-grade AGI constituted the observation group, and 143 patients without high-grade AGI served as the control group. A three-stage variable screening strategy based on LASSO regression was employed to identify core predictors. A predictive model was then constructed using binary logistic regression and internally validated via the bootstrap method. Results Hyperlipidemia was the most common etiology of MSAP. Multivariate analysis identified hyperlipidemic etiology, plasma D-dimer level, and length of hospital stay as independent risk factors for high-grade AGI, while age at diagnosis, serum potassium (K+), and serum calcium (Ca2+) were protective factors. The final model demonstrated an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.877, which increased to 0.888 after bootstrap validation. The model's sensitivity was 80.3% and specificity was 81.5%. Conclusion Hyperlipidemic etiology, plasma D-dimer, and length of hospital stay are independent risk factors for high-grade AGI complicating MSAP, whereas K⁺, Ca²⁺, and age at diagnosis are protective factors for high-grade AGI complicating MSAP.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现高脂血症病因、血浆D-二聚体水平和住院时间是MSAP并发高等级急性胃肠损伤（AGI≥3级）的独立危险因素，而诊断时年龄、血清钾和钙是保护因素；基于这些因素构建的预测模型AUC为0.877，经内部验证后为0.888。

items.title_cn: 美国急性胰腺炎发作次数与新发糖尿病风险的关系：一项真实世界数据分析
items.title_en: Relationship Between Number of Acute Pancreatitis Episodes and Risk of New-onset Diabetes in the U.S.: A Real-world Data Analysis
items.abstract_cn: 引言：急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种常见的炎症性疾病，与糖尿病（DM）风险增加相关。目前尚不明确复发性急性胰腺炎（RAP）是否与新发DM风险进一步增加有关。本研究旨在利用真实世界数据探讨RAP与新发DM之间的关联。方法：我们使用Merative™ MarketScan®索赔数据库（2016-2023年）开展了一项回顾性队列研究，纳入基线时患有AP且无DM病史的患者。主要暴露因素为RAP，定义为在首次AP诊断后≥90天发生一次或多次AP发作；而单次AP发作（SAP）指在首次事件后90天内无后续复发的单次AP发作。采用多变量分层Cox比例风险回归模型，通过ICD-10编码确定RAP与新发DM之间的关联。结果：共有16,184例AP患者（平均[SD]年龄：45.8 [12.3]岁）贡献了40,712人年的随访时间，期间记录了1,477例新发DM病例。与SAP患者相比，RAP患者新发DM的风险增加（调整后HR，1.92；95% CI，1.61-2.29）。随着RAP发作频率的增加，风险显著升高。在比较患者人口统计学特征和合并症的修饰效应时，女性中RAP与新发DM之间的关联更强（调整后HR，2.44；95% CI，1.87-3.19），而男性中为（调整后HR，1.64；95% CI，1.30-2.07；交互作用P=0.03）。此外，年轻患者（18-46岁）（调整后HR=2.56；95% CI，1.97-3.31）和非烟草滥用者（调整后HR=2.19；95% CI，1.81-2.65）中观察到更强的关联，所有比较均存在显著交互作用（交互作用P<0.05）。结论：在这项真实世界研究中，RAP与新发DM风险增加相关。我们的研究结果强调了为RAP患者提供血糖监测和主动管理的契机，以降低其发生DM的风险。
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a common inflammatory disorder that is associated with increased risk for diabetes mellitus (DM). It remains unclear whether recurrent acute pancreatitis (RAP) is associated with further increased risk of incident DM. This study aims to investigate the association between RAP and incident DM using real-world data. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the MerativeTM MarketScan® claims database (2016-2023), identifying patients with AP and no prior history of DM at baseline. The primary exposure of interest, RAP, was defined as one or more episodes of AP occurring ≥90 days after the index AP diagnosis, whereas one episode of AP referred to a single episode of AP (SAP) with no subsequent recurrence within 90 days following the index event. A multivariable stratified Cox proportional hazards regression models were used to determine the association between RAP and incident DM, identified using ICD-10 codes. RESULTS: In total, 16,184 individuals with AP (mean [SD] age: 45.8 [12.3]) contributed 40,712 person-years of follow-up, during which 1,477 incident cases of DM were documented. Individuals with RAP had an increased risk of incident DM compared with those with a SAP(adjusted HR, 1.92; 95% CI, 1.61-2.29). The risk increased significantly with the frequency of RAP. In comparing the modifying effect of patient demographics and comorbidities, a stronger association between RAP and incident DM was observed in females (adjusted HR, 2.44; 95% CI, 1.87-3.19) than in males (adjusted HR, 1.64; 95% CI, 1.30-2.07; Pinteraction=0.03). Also, stronger associations were observed among younger patients (18-46 y) (adjusted HR=2.56; 95% CI, 1.97-3.31) and among non-tobacco abuse (adjusted HR=2.19; 95% CI, 1.81-2.65), with significant interactions for all comparisons (Pinteraction<0.05. CONCLUSIONS: In this real-world study, RAP was associated with an increased risk of incident DM. Our findings highlight an opportunity for glycemic monitoring and proactive management of patients with RAP to mitigate their risk of developing DM.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现复发性急性胰腺炎（RAP）患者新发糖尿病的风险显著高于单次急性胰腺炎患者（调整后HR=1.92），且风险随复发次数增加而升高，在女性和年轻患者中关联更强。

items.title_cn: 间歇性气压治疗预防重症急性胰腺炎患者下肢深静脉血栓的系统评价与Meta分析
items.title_en: Intermittent Pneumatic Compression for Preventing Lower Extremity Deep Vein Thrombosis in Patients with Severe Acute Pancreatitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.abstract_cn: 系统评价间歇性充气加压（IPC）预防重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）患者下肢深静脉血栓形成（DVT）的有效性和安全性。检索PubMed、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、CNKI、万方、维普和中国生物医学文献数据库中自建库至2026年4月30日发表的关于IPC预防SAP患者DVT的随机对照试验（RCTs）和非随机对照试验。两名研究者独立筛选文献、提取数据并评估偏倚风险。采用R软件（版本4.2.2）进行Meta分析。根据研究设计和治疗频率进行亚组分析。本综述已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420261379348）。共纳入10项研究（7项RCT和3项非RCT），涉及970例患者（干预组484例，对照组486例）。Meta分析显示，IPC显著降低了DVT的发生率（RR = 0.22，95% CI 0.13–0.38，P < 0.0001，I² = 0%）。IPC还降低了纤维蛋白原水平（MD = –1.05，95% CI –1.50至–0.59，P < 0.0001，I² = 97%），延长了活化部分凝血活酶时间（APTT）（MD = 5.94，95% CI 2.46–9.42，P < 0.0001，I² = 94%）和凝血酶原时间（PT）（MD = 1.82，95% CI 1.24–2.40，P < 0.0001，I² = 85%），并增加了峰值血流速度（MD = 9.82，95% CI 7.63–12.00，P < 0.0001，I² = 83%）和平均血流速度（MD = 8.12，95% CI 5.66–10.59，P < 0.0001，I² = 95%）。亚组分析表明，研究设计和治疗频率（每日两次与每日四次）对DVT预防效果无显著影响。所有纳入研究均未报告与IPC相关的严重不良事件。间歇性充气加压可降低SAP患者DVT风险，改善高凝状态和下肢血流，且安全性良好。然而，证据的可信度受限于研究的地域集中性、异质性以及纳入非随机试验等因素。需要高质量研究来证实这些发现。
items.abstract_en: To systematically evaluate the efficacy and safety of intermittent pneumatic compression (IPC) in preventing lower extremity deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in patients with severe acute pancreatitis (SAP). Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and non-randomized controlled trials on IPC for DVT prevention in SAP patients were retrieved from PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, and the Chinese Biomedical Literature Database from inception to 30 April 2026. Two reviewers independently screened the literature, extracted data, and assessed the risk of bias. Meta-analyses were performed using R software (version 4.2.2). Subgroup analyses were conducted based on study design and treatment frequency. This review is registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261379348). A total of 10 studies (7 RCTs and 3 non-RCTs) involving 970 patients (484 in the intervention group and 486 in the control group) were included. Meta-analysis showed that IPC significantly reduced the incidence of DVT (RR = 0.22, 95% CI 0.13 – 0.38, P < 0.0001, I 2 = 0%). IPC also reduced fibrinogen levels (MD = – 1.05, 95% CI – 1.50 to – 0.59, P < 0.0001, I 2 = 97%), prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time (APTT) (MD = 5.94, 95% CI 2.46 – 9.42, P < 0.0001, I 2 = 94%) and prothrombin time (PT) (MD = 1.82, 95% CI 1.24 – 2.40, P < 0.0001, I 2 = 85%), and increased peak blood flow velocity (MD = 9.82, 95% CI 7.63 – 12.00, P < 0.0001, I 2 = 83%) and mean blood flow velocity (MD = 8.12, 95% CI 5.66 – 10.59, P < 0.0001, I 2 = 95%). Subgroup analyses indicated that study design and treatment frequency (twice daily vs. four times daily) did not significantly affect DVT prevention outcomes. No serious adverse events related to IPC were reported in any of the included studies. Intermittent pneumatic compression may reduce DVT risk, improve hypercoagulability and lower extremity blood flow in SAP patients, with a favourable safety profile. However, confidence in the evidence is limited by the geographical concentration of the studies, heterogeneity, and inclusion of non‑randomised trials. High‑quality studies are needed to confirm these findings.
items.summary_cn: Intermittent pneumatic compression significantly reduced the incidence of lower extremity deep vein thrombosis, improved hypercoagulability and lower extremity blood flow in patients with severe acute pancreatitis, with a favorable safety profile.

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
